_help: days    : '3-6' range | '1,3,5' list | '2-8/2' every other | '4' one day
times   : M=Morning A=Afternoon E=Evening N=Night B=Bedtime. Combine: 'M,A' or 'M,A,E,N'. No times = M,A,E,N: Bedtime must be listed
move    : bare pattern name, or {pattern, speed, distance, axis, radius}
requires: 'beaten: NAME' | 'met: NAME' | 'flag: NAME', any prefixed with 'not '.
Compound gates use the longhand object form.
when    : optional rule list, evaluated TOP TO BOTTOM, FIRST MATCH WINS.
A rule states when the character is present plus ONLY what differs.
Anything a rule omits falls back to the character's own value above.
loop    : set false for story characters who must never repeat when the
calendar loops -- they are matched against the real day instead.
WHO IS BEHIND THE COUNTER. Exactly one of Olly / Alexander at every time slot. The
calendar mirrors Celeste Harbour's (authored through day 8, days 5-8 loop for ever):
day 1 Olly M,A  Alexander E,N | 2 Olly all day, no Alexander (bank holiday) | 3 Olly M,E  Alexander A,N
Day 2 Morning: Olly only once flag cafe_olly_gone is up (he is at the cafe until then,
and BaseMapScene._locked_door_text keeps the FISH door locked until he has been played).
4 Alexander M,A,E  Olly N | 5 Olly M,A  Alexander E,N | 6 Alexander M,E  Olly A,N
7 Olly M,E  Alexander A,N | 8 Alexander M,E  Olly A,N
Both share shop_id 'fish_shop'. What they SAY is not here: it is milestone-driven,
in Scripts/Objects_And_Classes/Fishing/Fish_Shop_Dialogue.gd. 'at' puts them centred
on the Desk collision with their feet on its top edge (MART/NPCS is at (121, 59)).
